title: Explorer canvas
description: One canvas file, stored as data/canvases/<name>.json. Windows reference each other in SQL as {{title}}. Window titles must be unique across the canvas; JSON Schema cannot enforce this, so the server must check it. Window ids must also be unique, and every links[].from/to must name an existing window id.

version.description: Schema version. Only 1 is valid today.

name.description: Canvas name. Also the file stem (data/canvases/<name>.json). Uses the same character set that dbx.safe() produces, so name === safe(name).

profile.description: Databricks CLI profile the canvas was created under.

warehouse_id.description: SQL warehouse id, or null when none is selected.

links.description: Derived from {{title}} references and kept only for drawing read-only edges. The {{title}} references in each window's sql are the source of truth; clients must not edit windows based on links.

id.description: Unique within the canvas. Used by links.

title.description: Unique within the canvas (not enforced by JSON Schema; the server must check it). Used in {{title}} references, so it must not contain braces.

sql.description: SQL text for a query window. May contain {{title}} references. Required when type is query.

vega_lite.description: Vega-Lite v5 spec. Required when type is chart.

text.description: Markdown body of a note window. Required when type is note.

table.description: Full name catalog.schema.table shown by a table window. Required when type is table.

editor_split.description: Query windows only. Percent of the window body the SQL editor takes. Absent means the default split.

from.description: Id of the referenced window (the upstream one).

to.description: Id of the window that references it (the downstream one).
